title: Unlinked failure gate: leaving test refuses while a checkpoint case's latest observation failed and no local bug links it (issue 39)
description: Unlinked failure gate: leaving test refuses while a checkpoint case's latest observation failed and no local bug links it (issue 39)
acceptance_criteria: Leaving test for accept, by advance or skip, is refused with refused:unlinked-failure while the latest observation of a case referenced in the checkpoint failed and no local bug links that observation; the refusal names the case, the observation and both remedies
The same move is allowed once a later observation of that case passed or any local bug links the failed observation; open blocking bugs keep refused:blocking-bugs
Observations that are stale but not failed, failed observations of cases not referenced in the checkpoint, and other stage moves are not affected
At test, chough next and chough status name the same refusal as the next action from the same rule, within the existing next bounds
A Linux reproduction of issue 39 fails before the fix and passes after, with new tests in tests/stages.rs failing first; the verify lane passes locally and CI is reported only as observed

answers.constraints: specs/cli/context.md lessons: tasks.md checkboxes block change check (2026-10-31); new requirement IDs materialize only at change check (2026-10-31); do not list .chough/ as an affected path and MODIFIED needs an exact REQ heading (2026-11-01); closeout is the last checkbox, done before the scoped check (2026-11-01); case recording is never a tasks.md checkbox (PR #41)
